label: RCT
definition: Carries a `treat` column: an experimental assignment is recorded alongside the responses.

label: Longitudinal
definition: Flagged longitudinal by 01_metadata.R. That flag greps the concatenated variable string, so it also matches names like cov_birthdate and cov_startdate; 9 of its members match only that way.

label: Intensive longitudinal
definition: Has both `date` and `wave`. Timestamped repeated measures: daily diaries, panel waves and experience sampling are all included, so this is not an EMA collection.

label: Response time
definition: Carries `rt`: per-response latencies are available.

label: Rater-mediated
definition: Carries `rater`: responses are attributed to a judge, not only to a respondent.

label: Multistage / booklet
definition: Carries `booklet` or `block_id`: items were administered in structured blocks.

label: Clustered
definition: Carries `cluster_id`: respondents are nested in groups.

label: Item position
definition: Carries `position`: administration order is recorded per response.

label: Q matrix
definition: Carries qmatrix* columns, the IRW standard item-by-attribute encoding for cognitive diagnostic modeling (datastandard.md).

label: Continuous response
definition: Responses fall on a (near-)continuous scale rather than a small ordered set. Not derivable: item_format and n_categories disagree on most candidates, so membership is curated. Seeded from irw_site/continuous_scout_candidates.csv; see continuous_response.review.csv for unpromoted candidates.

label: Big Five / FFM
definition: Five-factor and HEXACO personality inventories, including tables covering a single subscale.

label: Dark Triad
definition: Narcissism, Machiavellianism and psychopathy measures.

label: PROMIS
definition: The PROMIS instrument family.

label: International assessments
definition: Large-scale international assessments: PISA, TIMSS, PIRLS, NAEP.

label: PANAS affect
definition: The Positive and Negative Affect Schedule.

label: Self-esteem
definition: Rosenberg and other self-esteem scales.

label: Mindfulness
definition: Mindfulness inventories including FFMQ and MAAS.

label: Mathematics
definition: Mathematics attainment and closely related constructs.

label: Anxiety
definition: Anxiety scales including GAD-7 and STAI.

label: Depression
definition: Depression scales including PHQ, CES-D, BDI and DASS.

label: Reading & vocabulary
definition: Reading, vocabulary, lexical and spelling measures.

label: Wellbeing
definition: Wellbeing, life satisfaction and quality of life measures.
